description: This file defines an Angular service 'AssetProfileService' that provides methods to interact with asset profile APIs, including fetching, saving, deleting, and setting default asset profiles. It uses HttpClient for HTTP requests and includes methods for retrieving asset profile data and info, as well as exporting profiles.

classes.name: AssetProfileService
classes.description: Angular service class providing methods to manage asset profiles via HTTP API calls.

methods.name: getAssetProfiles
methods.description: Fetches a paginated list of asset profiles.

methods.name: getAssetProfilesByIds
methods.description: Retrieves asset profile info objects by their IDs.

methods.name: getAssetProfile
methods.description: Fetches a specific asset profile by ID.

methods.name: exportAssetProfile
methods.description: Exports an asset profile, possibly with inline images.

methods.name: saveAssetProfile
methods.description: Saves a new or updated asset profile.

methods.name: deleteAssetProfile
methods.description: Deletes an asset profile by ID.

methods.name: setDefaultAssetProfile
methods.description: Sets an asset profile as default.

methods.name: getDefaultAssetProfileInfo
methods.description: Retrieves info of the default asset profile.

methods.name: getAssetProfileInfo
methods.description: Fetches detailed info of an asset profile by ID.

methods.name: getAssetProfileInfos
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of asset profile info objects.

methods.name: getAssetProfileNames
methods.description: Retrieves names of asset profiles, optionally only active ones.
